QF.id: Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_20

question.text: Under SEBI categorization, Solution-Oriented Schemes include which of the following?

answer.text: Retirement Benefit Scheme and Children's Fund
Capital Protection Oriented Fund and Fixed Maturity Plan
Balanced Advantage Fund and Multi-Asset Allocation Fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 48-53 of the workbook, SEBI categorization places exactly two sub-categories under Solution Oriented Schemes: (1) Retirement Fund and (2) Children's Fund. The Trap: ELSS sits under Equity Schemes, not Solution Oriented. Arbitrage Fund, Balanced Advantage Fund, and Multi-Asset Allocation Fund fall under Hybrid Schemes. The workbook's Other Schemes list comprises Index Funds/ETFs and Fund of Funds; Capital Protection Oriented Funds are discussed separately (page 54) and are not part of the Other Schemes list. Note: The five broad SEBI categories are Equity, Debt, Hybrid, Solution Oriented, and Other; keep the placement of each named scheme aligned with these workbook lists.
